Messages.Author: Pat
Messages.Body:
Sleeping Mind, The

Type: Action Modifier

Requires: Dominate

Cost: 1 blood

Only usable when the acting vampire's action is announced.

[dom] Choose a tapped vampire. The chosen vampire cannot attempt to block
this action.

[DOM] Only usable when the acting vampire's action is announced. Minions
cannot untap during this action.

Question: If there are no other tapped vampires on the table, can the acting
vampire name herself as "the chosen vampire" for the [dom] effect?

Thx in advance.

- Pat

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
Pat wrote:
> Question: If there are no other tapped vampires on the table, can the acting
> vampire name herself as "the chosen vampire" for the [dom] effect?

Sure.
